title: Freshman/Sophomore Seminar in History; A History of Drugs from Ayahuasca to Zantac
description: The term "drug" has meant many things over its long history, ranging from a remedy to a banned substance. In this seminar we'll explore the term's history and see how it has changed over time. Topics include global trade, cultural appropriation, healthcare. politics, law, technology, and big pharma.
